name: What are the most impactful upgrades for a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What are the most impactful upgrades for a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For small bathrooms, the most impactful upgrades often involve maximizing space and improving aesthetics. These include installing a floating vanity or pedestal sink to free up floor space, choosing a lighter color palette for walls and tiles to make the room feel larger, and upgrading lighting fixtures for better illumination. Consider a walk-in shower with a glass enclosure instead of a bulky tub to visually expand the area, a popular choice for enhancing functionality in compact spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Impactful small bathroom upgrades include floating vanities, lighter color palettes, improved lighting, and walk-in showers to maximize space and aesthetics.
